name: Zigbee2MQTT
short_desc: Zigbee to MQTT bridge (network or USB adapter)
author: @Koenkk
description: Zigbee to MQTT bridge — get rid of your proprietary Zigbee bridges. This build of Zigbee2MQTT drops the mandatory USB device passthrough so it works with a network (TCP/serial-over-IP) Zigbee adapter such as a SLZB-06 or a ser2net host. The adapter is configured via the Serial port field (e.g. tcp://192.168.68.100:6638). For a local USB stick you would still need to add a docker device mapping manually.

form_fields.label: Serial port (adapter)
form_fields.hint: Network adapter: tcp://<host>:<port> (e.g. tcp://192.168.68.100:6638). USB adapter: a /dev path (also requires a manual device mapping).
